NBA DFS Picks for Saturday, November 14 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, November 14 · 5 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 14, 11:31 AM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) is the top-projected player on the Saturday, November 14 DraftKings main slate at 64.6 DraftKings points for $11,700. Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA, 53.8, $11,500) and Cade Cunningham (DET, 50.4, $9,800) are next.

Jarrett Allen (CLE) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.70 projected points per $1,000 at $5,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 14, 11:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
